rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when mercy means compassion or a merciful character.

example.english: They have a lot of mercy in their hearts and always help neighbours in need.

rows.note: Use this when mercy means sparing someone from harm, punishment, or embarrassment.
Use this when “a mercy” means a fortunate outcome or something to be thankful for.

example.english: It was a mercy that you caught the train in time.
